svg.text: Two Powerpole cut-outs 24 x 25: 23 to 47 and 68 to 92 from the front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, 25 to 50 up. Size them to the panel-mount housing you buy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm screw holes: 6 and 106 from the front edge, 20 and 55 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: over the window in the door end wall, above the intake slots,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four M4 screws into the rivet nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DC in on the front cut-out, charger in on the back one; the housings

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: are turned differently so the two plugs cannot be swapped.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each plug mates with only its own socket.
